questions.stemEn: A 2-year-old has recurrent wheezing after upper respiratory infections. Which finding most strongly increases the chance of persistent asthma later in childhood according to the Asthma Predictive Index?
questions.explanationAr: في Asthma Predictive Index، physician-diagnosed eczema من major criteria. وجود recurrent wheeze مع major criterion يرفع احتمال persistent asthma لاحقًا.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: بعض الخيارات قد تكون risk markers لكنها ليست بنفس وزن major criterion المذكور في API التقليدي. Eosinophilia تُعد minor criterion في الصيغ الشائعة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Physician-diagnosed eczema is a major Asthma Predictive Index criterion.

tts.text: A two-year-old has recurrent wheezing after upper respiratory infections. Which finding most strongly increases the chance of persistent asthma later in childhood according to the Asthma Predictive Index? Option A, physician-diagnosed eczema. Option B, personal history of food allergy. Option C, family history of food allergy. Option D, eosinophilia. Option E, allergic rhinitis.

questions.stemEn: A 7-year-old with asthma remains poorly controlled despite high-dose inhaled corticosteroid, long-acting beta-agonist and montelukast. Allergy testing is positive to perennial aeroallergens and serum IgE is elevated. Which add-on treatment is most appropriate?
questions.explanationAr: هذا severe allergic asthma غير مضبوط رغم controller therapy المناسبة، مع sensitization وارتفاع IgE. Omalizumab anti-IgE biologic مناسب في المرضى المؤهلين حسب العمر والوزن ومستوى IgE والحساسية المثبتة.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Chronic oral steroids ليست الخيار المفضل بسبب toxicity طويلة المدى. الاستمرار دون escalation غير مناسب مع persistent uncontrolled symptoms.
questions.clinicalPearl: Omalizumab is an anti-IgE biologic for selected patients with uncontrolled allergic asthma.

tts.text: A seven-year-old with asthma remains poorly controlled despite high-dose inhaled corticosteroid, long-acting beta-agonist and montelukast. Allergy testing is positive to perennial aeroallergens and serum IgE is elevated. Which add-on treatment is most appropriate? Option A, omalizumab. Option B, chronic oral steroid. Option C, continue the same regimen only.

questions.stemEn: Which medication class is most effective at reducing the late inflammatory phase of an asthma exacerbation?
questions.explanationAr: Corticosteroids تقلل late-phase inflammatory response في asthma عبر تقليل airway inflammation وhyperresponsiveness وهجرة الخلايا الالتهابية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Systemic corticosteroids blunt the late inflammatory phase of asthma exacerbations.

tts.text: Which medication class is most effective at reducing the late inflammatory phase of an asthma exacerbation? Option A, methylprednisolone.

questions.stemEn: A child with an acute asthma exacerbation has persistent cough and respiratory distress despite three back-to-back salbutamol treatments. Which therapy should be added next among the listed options?
questions.explanationAr: Systemic corticosteroid يجب إعطاؤه مبكرًا في moderate-to-severe asthma exacerbation لأنه يقلل airway inflammation ويمنع استمرار النوبة. Magnesium أو continuous beta-agonist يُستخدمان عند استمرار الشدة بعد العلاج الأولي حسب الحالة.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Magnesium sulfate وcontinuous salbutamol خيارات escalation للحالات الشديدة أو غير المستجيبة، لكن systemic steroid جزء أساسي ومبكر من العلاج.
questions.clinicalPearl: Early systemic corticosteroids are a core component of moderate-to-severe acute asthma treatment.

tts.text: A child with an acute asthma exacerbation has persistent cough and respiratory distress despite three back-to-back salbutamol treatments. Which therapy should be added next among the listed options? Option A, systemic corticosteroid. Option B, magnesium sulfate. Option C, continuous salbutamol nebulization. Option D, intravenous salbutamol.

questions.stemEn: Which adjunct has demonstrated meaningful benefit when added in the emergency department for a child with a moderate-to-severe asthma exacerbation?
questions.explanationAr: Adding inhaled ipratropium إلى short-acting beta-agonist في moderate-to-severe exacerbation يمكن أن يحسن lung function ويقلل admission. Heliox وaminophylline وsystemic beta-agonists أدوارها أضيق وأقل routine.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Heliox يُحجز لحالات مختارة. Aminophylline فائدته الإضافية محدودة مع modern inhaled therapy. Systemic terbutaline يُستخدم عند صعوبة إيصال inhaled therapy أو في refractory severe attacks.
questions.clinicalPearl: Ipratropium plus SABA is beneficial early in moderate-to-severe pediatric asthma exacerbations.

tts.text: Which adjunct has demonstrated meaningful benefit when added in the emergency department for a child with a moderate-to-severe asthma exacerbation? Option A, ipratropium bromide. Option B, heliox. Option C, aminophylline. Option D, systemic terbutaline.

questions.stemEn: Which cardiovascular effect can occur with intensive salbutamol therapy?
questions.explanationAr: Intensive beta-agonist therapy يسبب peripheral vasodilation وtachycardia وقد يؤدي إلى انخفاض diastolic blood pressure.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Hypocalcemia وexcessive salivation ليست adverse effects نموذجية للسالبوتامول. Systolic hypotension ليست النمط الكلاسيكي المذكور هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: High-dose beta-agonists can cause tachycardia and diastolic hypotension through peripheral vasodilation.

tts.text: Which cardiovascular effect can occur with intensive salbutamol therapy? Option A, diastolic hypotension. Option B, systolic hypotension. Option C, hypocalcemia. Option D, excessive salivation.

questions.stemEn: A child with severe asthma receives repeated or continuous salbutamol and later develops ECG changes consistent with potassium depletion. Which laboratory abnormality is expected?
questions.explanationAr: Beta-2 agonists تنشط Na/K ATPase وتدفع potassium إلى داخل الخلايا، لذلك قد يظهر transient hypokalemia مع repeated or continuous salbutamol. ECG قد يُظهر flat T waves وU waves.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Hyperkalemia عكس المتوقع. Hypocalcemia ليست الاضطراب الأساسي الناتج عن beta-2 agonist هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Continuous albuterol can produce clinically relevant transient hypokalemia.
managementSteps: Monitor potassium in prolonged high-dose therapy when clinically indicated

questions.stemEn: A child has cough triggered by exercise. Which bronchoprovocation test can be used to evaluate exercise-induced bronchoconstriction if a direct exercise challenge is not available?
questions.explanationAr: الـdirect exercise challenge هو الاختبار الأكثر مباشرة لـexercise-induced bronchoconstriction. Methacholine challenge يمكن استخدامه كsurrogate bronchoprovocation test إذا لم يتوفر exercise challenge، لذلك جواب التجميع مقبول ضمن صياغة الخيارات.
questions.clinicalPearl: A standardized exercise challenge is preferred for EIB; methacholine is an alternative bronchoprovocation test.
diagnosticSteps: Spirometry before and after exercise challenge when available

tts.text: A child has cough triggered by exercise. Which bronchoprovocation test can be used to evaluate exercise-induced bronchoconstriction if a direct exercise challenge is not available? Option A, methacholine challenge test.

questions.stemEn: Which spirometric measurement is most useful for distinguishing airflow limitation severity in a child with asthma among the listed choices?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه غير متأكد من الإجابة. FEV1 وFEV1/FVC كلاهما مهمان، كما أن modern asthma severity classification يعتمد أيضًا على symptom burden والعلاج المطلوب وليس spirometry وحدها. لذلك هذا السؤال يبقى conflicting حتى التحقق النهائي.
questions.clinicalPearl: Asthma severity cannot be reliably classified from a single spirometric number alone.

tts.text: Which spirometric measurement is most useful for distinguishing airflow limitation severity in a child with asthma among the listed choices? Option A, baseline FEV one over FVC. Option B, baseline FEV one. Option C, bronchodilator response.

questions.stemEn: Spirometry shows an increase in FEV1 of 16% after bronchodilator. What does this finding support?

options.text: Reversible obstructive airway disease consistent with asthma

questions.explanationAr: ارتفاع FEV1 بشكل واضح بعد bronchodilator يدعم reversible airflow obstruction، وهو نمط يتماشى مع asthma. لكن لا يمكن تحديد severity مثل 'mild' من هذه النتيجة وحدها.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: النتيجة ليست normal إذا كان هناك significant bronchodilator response، ولا تدعم irreversible disease. وصف severity يحتاج symptom control وrisk وعوامل أخرى.
questions.clinicalPearl: A significant bronchodilator response supports reversible obstructive airway disease.
diagnosticSteps: Interpret spirometry with age-appropriate reference values and clinical context

tts.text: Spirometry shows an increase in FEV one of sixteen percent after bronchodilator. What does this finding support? Option A, normal result. Option B, partially reversible disease. Option C, mild irreversible disease. Option D, reversible obstructive airway disease consistent with asthma.
